senses.gloss:
1 रु रौति रुव॑ति रवति रवते pp. रुत॑ (q.v.)
roar, howl, shriek, croak, sound, thunder. C. रावयति cause to roar
or cry, fill with cries. I. रोरवीति, रोरूयते, ˚ति roar or cry out
loudly. — अभि & आ roar etc. (at or against). प्र roar or cry
aloud. वि roar, yelp, shout, creak, rattle, tinkle;
 cry or call at. C.
cry aloud, make resound. — Cf. अभिरुत, विरुत.
